SELECT T1.state, T1.enr FROM college AS T1 JOIN tryout AS T2 ON T1.cName = T2.cName WHERE T2.decision = 'accept'
SELECT cName FROM College WHERE enr > 15000 AND state = "LA" UNION SELECT cName FROM College WHERE enr < 13000 AND state = "AZ"
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tryout WHERE pPos IN ('goalie', 'mid')
SELECT DISTINCT state FROM college WHERE enr < (SELECT max(enr) FROM college)
SELECT title FROM albums WHERE title LIKE 'A%' ORDER BY title ASC
SELECT billing_state, COUNT(*) AS number_of_invoices FROM invoices GROUP BY billing_state ORDER BY number_of_invoices DESC
SELECT company FROM customers WHERE first_name = "Eduardo" AND last_name = "Martins"
SELECT address FROM employees WHERE first_name = "Nancy" AND last_name = "Edwards"
SELECT name FROM playlists
SELECT T1.title FROM albums AS T1 JOIN tracks AS T2 ON T2.album_id = T1.id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING COUNT(T2.id) > 10
SELECT AVG(LifeExpectancy) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Africa' AND GovernmentForm = 'Republic'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Continent) FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language = 'Chinese'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Region FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language = "English" OR T2.Language = "Dutch"
SELECT sum(Population), avg(LifeExpectancy), Continent FROM country GROUP BY Continent HAVING avg(LifeExpectancy) < 72
SELECT Name FROM country ORDER BY Population ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT Name FROM city WHERE Population BETWEEN 160000 AND 900000
